device.description: 24-bit 15 SPS delta-sigma ADC with 2-wire serial interface (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK), self-calibration, MSOP-10
device.note: ads1244.pdf (SBAS273) p.2 pin configuration and descriptions, p.3 electrical characteristics (data rate 15 SPS at fCLK = 2.4576 MHz, VIH (CLK, SCLK) 2.1-5.25 V, DVDD 1.8-3.6 V), p.8 DRDY/DOUT, SCLK, p.10 power-up, data format (Table I), p.11 data retrieval timing (Figure 12: t5 = 50 ns, t8 = 66.667 ms), p.12-13 self-calibration, sleep mode, single conversions

pages: p.2 (pins), p.3 (EC), p.8 (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK), p.10 (power-up, data format), p.11 (retrieval timing), p.12-13 (calibration, sleep)
notModeled: conversion time is t8 = 66.667 ms at fCLK = 2.4576 MHz (the data rate scales with the CLK pin frequency, up to 6 MHz; CLK is not used by the model)
power-up self-calibration (first data after t1 + t2, about 350 ms) is not timed: the first conversion completes 66.667 ms after power-on
DRDY/DOUT stays at the last data bit until the next update unless a 25th SCLK forces it high; modeled as idle 1 after the 24 bits
self-calibration started by 26 SCLKs (t9 = 210 ms), sleep mode (SCLK held high after DRDY/DOUT falls) and its wake-up, sleep with self-calibration, single conversions by sleep/wake-up
data-update window t7 (152 us, no readback)
variants: ADS1245 (buffered input, pin-compatible, ads1245.pdf): own spec file
